symbols.note: from gatekit symbols system --dll dx11 --full; '-' addresses (null) mean the method was not found in bg3_dx11.exe; the component lists come from the method parameter types, not from the code.
symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Per-frame order: GatherDirtyLoadStates, ProcessSaveRequests, ProcessLoadRequests, ProcessLevelUpRequests, then a long inlined block (the dirty load session and load state handling), ProcessDirtyLevelUpStates and ProcessPostReloadStoryEvent. Requests arrive as stored values, not components.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll named pseudo-code, Update (204 lines): the six calls and their order were read.

does.text: Stores a level number for an entity in the system's own map (a one-line setter). ProcessLevelUpRequests copies a value stored under a null handle to every party character, then for each character whose current value is below the requested one adds esv::exp::IncreaseExperienceRequestOneFrameComponent (an amount computed from the two values) and esv::party_preset::LevelUpStateComponent. The client calls this through the party preset protocol (SendLevelUpRequest).
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll named pseudo-code, RequestLevelUp (21 lines). Review (Opus, 14 Nov): ProcessLevelUpRequests at EoCServer.dll+0xA7DF60: the less-than test guards helper +0xA76BE0 (AllocRaw of DAT_182219a40 = IncreaseExperienceRequestOneFrameComponent) and +0xA76DD0 (AllocRaw of DAT_182234ecc = LevelUpStateComponent). What the compared value is (level or XP) was not read. Client: ecl::PartyPresetProtocol::SendLevelUpRequest at EoCClient.dll+0xEC7030 (name only).

does.text: Loads a party preset into the party's characters. It refuses with a logged message when called during character creation or when a party member is in a timeline, and logs an error when a level-up selector in the preset no longer exists in game data. On success it sets up the characters from the preset (background, origin, appearance, voice, tags are in the system's write list) and teleports them (TeleportEntity). Whether it creates LoadSession or LevelUpState components here was not read.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll named pseudo-code, ProcessLoadRequests at EoCServer.dll+0xA7E2B0 (826 lines): only its error strings were read. The client protocol also has SendLoadRequest and SendSaveRequest.

does.text: Advances the per-character load state for characters being loaded: it reports 'Missing load state component, something's wrong with party preset load flow' if the state is absent, 'Invalid preset state', and 'Failed to load item ... into inventory'. So a per-character load-state component exists during a load; by the system's component list that is LoadSessionComponent or a sibling, not confirmed.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll named pseudo-code, ProcessDirtyLoadStates (622 lines): log strings only.

does.text: For entities returned by an 'added' query it REMOVES LevelUpStateComponent and adds esv::character_creation::AutoLevelRequestOneFrameComponent, handing the level-up on to character creation. It does not create LevelUpState; ProcessLevelUpRequests does.
does.evidence: Review (Opus, 14 Nov): EoCServer.dll+0xA7C9D0: RemoveComponentUnchecked of DAT_182234ecc = LevelUpStateComponent, then helper +0xA76310, an AllocRaw add of DAT_182234f1c = AutoLevelRequestOneFrameComponent; the query is a spec at DAT_182234efc whose name starts with esv::exp::IncreaseExper (truncated). The author had this as adding LevelUpState.

does.text: Reacts to PartySystem's PostReloadStoryUpdateEvent one-frame component after a story reload (its signature includes that type) and continues a preset load that was waiting on the reload, including TeleportEntity.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll named pseudo-code, signature only plus the survey evidence that RequestLoad drains into ProcessPostReloadStoryEvent.

unknown: Where and under what condition LoadSessionComponent, LoadStateComponent and DebugSetTotalXPRequestOneFrameComponent are added: not resolved.
What a player does to start a preset load or level-up (the client has a PartyPresetProtocol with Load, Save and LevelUp requests; the trigger on the client side was not looked at).
sure: no: the level-up path (LevelUpState and IncreaseExperienceRequest added, LevelUpState removed for AutoLevelRequest) was read in review; the load path is from error strings
